pair.title: The Pointy extension in {browser} wants to connect
pair.body: Once allowed, shake the mouse in the browser to point at anything on a page, or choose “Ask Pointy” from the right-click menu.

welcome.title: Pointy is ready
welcome.shake: **Shake the mouse** to start pointing. Point at anything in a page, a document or a chat, click, and ask {agent}.
welcome.trayMac: The whale in the menu bar sets how hard to shake and turns on Do Not Disturb.
welcome.trayWin: The whale in the system tray sets how hard to shake and turns on Do Not Disturb.
welcome.extension: In a browser, install Pointy's browser extension to point at a single paragraph of a page.

guide.title: Install the browser extension (recommended)
guide.why: With the extension, Pointy can point at a paragraph or an image in a page, and the right-click menu gets “Ask Pointy”. Without it, Pointy still works and reads pages as a screenshot of the window.
guide.step1: 1. Open the extensions page from the address bar and turn on “Developer mode” in the top right.
guide.step2: 2. Click “Load unpacked”, paste this path into the address bar of the folder window, then click “Select Folder”.
guide.step3: 3. Once it is installed, Pointy asks whether to let it connect. Click “Allow”.
